gbm_population_evidence.quote: DB107-Retroviral Replicating Vector (RRV) Combined With DB107-Flucytosine (FC) in Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma or Anaplastic Astrocytoma
Patients with unresectable or resectable HGG (AA or GBM) will be enrolled.

candidate_evidence.quote: The purpose of this study is to determine if the investigational products, DB107-RRV and DB107-FC, as a combination treatment will shrink high-grade glioma (HGG) in patients with recurrent/progressive, resectable or unresectable disease and increase the time that disease is controlled.

candidate_flag.reason: Only pharmacological agent is flucytosine (DB107-FC), a prodrug whose antitumour effect depends on the co-administered gene-therapy vector; whether it counts as a candidate or as part of an excluded gene therapy needs adjudication.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Histologically proven HGG that have recurred/progressed (first or second recurrence).

role_evidence.quote: will receive combination intravenous (IV) and adaptive repeat intratumoral delivery of DB107-RRV in the vein (IV) and in the walls of the cavity that remains where tumor is removed.

agents.drug_class_hint: retroviral replicating vector (gene therapy), presumably delivering a prodrug-activating enzyme; DB107-RRV

role_evidence.quote: Approximately 6 weeks after surgery, patients will start drug therapy with a 7-day oral regimen of 220 mg/kg/day DB107-FC, which is to be self-administered.

A Biomarker-Guided Phase 2 Study of DB107-RRV (Retroviral Replicating Vector) Combined With DB107-Flucytosine Extended-Release Tablets in Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma or Anaplastic Astrocytoma

agents.drug_class_hint: antifungal (5-fluorocytosine), extended-release tablet, prodrug activated by vector-delivered enzyme

flag.reason: Antitumour effect depends on gene-therapy vector activation; candidate status of a gene-therapy-dependent prodrug is not explicitly covered by the manual.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: Denovo Genomic Marker 7 (DGM7), measured in blood

source_quote.quote: Presence of Denovo Genomic Marker 7 (DGM7) biomarker in blood.

flag.reason: Blood-based marker; record does not say whether it is a tumour or germline marker (germline markers are not recorded) nor its mechanistic link to the DB107 regimen.

coder_notes: Single-arm recurrent HGG (GBM or anaplastic astrocytoma) trial; glioblastoma named in title and inclusion criteria. DB107-RRV is a retroviral replicating vector (gene therapy) -> excluded_intervention_type. DB107-FC is extended-release flucytosine (brand names Ancobon/Ancotil given), the only small-molecule drug, coded as experimental_monotherapy but flagged because its antitumour activity requires the vector. regimen_id DB107 links the two components. DGM7 blood biomarker is an entry requirement; flagged since it may be germline and its link to the candidate is not stated. cns5_terminology unclear (no IDH/WHO reference; 'anaplastic astrocytoma' is older terminology but not one of the listed historical criteria).
